original_text: –Steps1.Make an Observation2.Ask a Question3.Make a Hypothesis4.Perform an Experiment(s)5.Collect and Analyze Data6.Make Conclusions
explanation: This slide outlines the six standard steps of the Scientific Method in sequential order: 1) Make an Observation, 2) Ask a Question, 3) Make a Hypothesis, 4) Perform an Experiment (or series of experiments), 5) Collect and Analyze Data, and 6) Make Conclusions.

questions.q: What is the correct order of the first three steps of the Scientific Method?
opts: Ask a Question -> Make an Observation -> Make a Hypothesis
Make a Hypothesis -> Perform an Experiment -> Collect Data
Make an Observation -> Ask a Question -> Make a Hypothesis
Perform an Experiment -> Collect Data -> Make Conclusions
questions.exp: According to the slide, the steps are: 1. Make an Observation, 2. Ask a Question, 3. Make a Hypothesis.
